verdict.rationale: Visual scripting is a fair axis for a game engine, but the evidence shows PlayCanvas gameplay logic is written as code: scripts are described as "reusable pieces of code" and the recommended format is ES Module `.mjs` class syntax. The Editor's "visual tools over code" mention covers drag-and-drop scene building, not node-based or visual authoring of gameplay logic. There is no evidence of a visual scripting system.
